thi-ap39:1.1: raṁsiphusitāveḷo → raṁsiphusitāvelo (bj, pts); raṁsirucitāveḷo (sya-all) | raṁsiphusitāvelo → S1 -putāvelo. (pts note)
thi-ap39:5.1: vesikāva → vesikā ca (sya-all) | va → S1 vā; S2 ca. (pts note)
thi-ap39:5.4: kammunā → kammanā (pts) | kammanā → S1 P. kammunā. (pts note)
thi-ap39:7.2: gaṇikattamakārayiṁ tamhā → gaṇikattaṁ akārayiṁ tato (sya-all) | gaṇikattaṁ → S1 gatikantaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap39:7.3: muccissaṁ bhutvā → vimuccissaṁ bhuttā (pts) | vimuccissaṁ → S1 tappāpa na vimuttiyaṁ; P. tamhā papā-. (pts note)
thi-ap39:8.1: brahmacariyamasevissaṁ → brahmavesamasevissaṁ (sya-all); brahmaceram asevissaṁ (pts) | Brahmacariyamasevissaṁ → brahmavesamasevissaṁ (cck: syā.); brahmaceramasevissaṁ (cck: pī.) | asevissaṁ → S1 asevīyaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap39:9.1: pacchime bhave → pacchimabhave (bj) | bhave sampatte → bhavasampatte (sya-all, pts) | bhavasampatte → S1 bhave sampatte. (pts note)
thi-ap39:10.1: pāṇakoṭīhi → S2 koṭihi; P. pāṇikoṭihi. (pts note)
thi-ap39:10.3: pattāhaṁ acalaṁ ṭhānaṁ → pattā haṁ acalaṭṭhānaṁ (pts) | haṁ → S2 sattāhaṁ. (pts note) | acalaṭṭhānaṁ → S1 P. acalaṁ ṭhānaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap39:11.4: mahāmuni pubbenivāsaṁ → mahāmune pubbe nivāsaṁ (bj) | mahāmuni → mahāmune (cck, sya-all) | mahāmuni → S1 mahāmuṇe. (pts note)
thi-ap39:12.2: dibbacakkhu → dibbacakkhuṁ (sya-all, pts) | visodhitaṁ → S1 dibbacakkhu-. (pts note)
thi-ap39:17.1: ambapāli → āyasmā ambapālī (sya-all) | Ambapālī → S1 Ambapāli; S2 Ambapālini. (pts note)
